questions.text: Analyze a continuous beam of two spans $AB = 6\,\text{m}$ and $BC = 4\,\text{m}$ with fixed support at $A$ and roller supports at $B$ and $C$ carrying a UDL of $30\,\text{kN/m}$ on span $AB$ and a central point load of $60\,\text{kN}$ on span $BC$ using the Method of Consistent Deformation (Force Method). Draw BMD and SFD.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Slope-Deflection Method for Continuous Beams & Frames
questions.text: Derive the Slope-Deflection Equations: $M_{AB} = M_{FAB} + \frac{2EI}{L}(2\theta_A + \theta_B - \frac{3\Delta}{L})$. Analyze a non-sway portal frame subjected to lateral point load and vertical loads using the Slope-Deflection Method and draw the Bending Moment Diagram.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Slope-Deflection Method for Continuous Beams & Frames
questions.text: Analyze a single-bay single-story Sway Portal Frame subjected to horizontal wind load $P = 40\,\text{kN}$ at joint $B$ using the Slope-Deflection Method with shear equilibrium equation.

Explain concepts in Moment Distribution Method: Stiffness factor ($k = 4EI/L$ for far end fixed, $k = 3EI/L$ for far end hinged), Distribution Factor ($DF = \frac{k}{\sum k}$), Carry-Over Factor ($COF = 0.5$). Analyze a continuous beam with support settlement of $10\,\text{mm}$ at middle support $B$ using the Moment Distribution Method.

Develop the Element Stiffness Matrix $[k]$ in local and global coordinate systems for: (a) 2D Truss Member ($4 \times 4$), and (b) 2D Beam/Frame Element ($6 \times 6$). Assemble the Structure Stiffness Matrix $[K]$ and solve for unknown joint displacements and member end forces for a continuous beam.

Define Plastic Hinge, Plastic Moment Capacity ($M_p = f_y Z_p$), Shape Factor ($S = Z_p / Z_e$), and Load Factor. Find the Shape Factor for: (a) Rectangular section ($S = 1.5$), (b) Circular section ($S = 1.7$), and (c) Symmetrical I-section ($S \approx 1.12-1.15$).

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Plastic Analysis of Beams & Portal Frames
questions.text: State the Upper Bound (Kinematic / Mechanism) Theorem and Lower Bound (Static) Theorem of Plastic Collapse. Calculate the True Plastic Collapse Load $W_c$ for a fixed-ended beam of span $L$ carrying an eccentric concentrated load $W$ at distance $a$ from left support using the Principle of Virtual Work.

questions.chapter: Chapter 6: Plastic Analysis of Beams & Portal Frames
questions.text: Determine the Plastic Collapse Load $W_c$ and draw plastic mechanisms (Beam mechanism, Sway mechanism, Combined mechanism) for a rectangular portal frame with vertical load $2W$ on beam and horizontal load $W$ at column top.

A practical engineering system operating under Force Method & Consistent Deformation Method is subjected to standard design loading and environmental conditions. Calculate the resulting parameters, safety factors, and verify whether all regulatory code limits are satisfied.
